SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000050
DOCKET NO. F 002530 22 CTL#163128
PLAINTIFF – U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, ETC.
DEFENDANTS- HOWARD BISCHOFF ET ALS
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 28th DAY OF April 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Township of Wayne, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Block 1514 Lot 5
Number of Feet to Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 100 feet from the easterly line of Kent Avenue to the southerly line of Mack Street
Dimensions (approx.): .229 AC
Upset Bid Amount: $245,489.02
Occupancy Status: Occupied
Amount Due for Taxes: Taxes due and owing in approximate amount of $4348.55 as of 11/21/25
Sale may be subject to subsequent taxes, liens, utilities and interest since 11/21/25
Water/Sewer due and in the approximate amount of $1736.58 as of 11/21/25
Subject to: All unpaid municipal taxes, assessments, liens and their charges; Any set of facts which an accurate survey would disclose; Any restrictions or covenants on record which run with the land; Rights of the United States of America, if any; Any Condominium lien priority pursuant to NJSA 46:88-21, if any; Any outstanding PUD or Homeowner's Associations dues or fees, if any; Any occupants or persons in possessions of the property, if any; Additional municipal charges, liens, taxes or tax sale certificates and insurance, if any; and any such taxes, municipal liens or other charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. The amount of unpaid taxes municipal liens and other charges can be obtained from the local taxing authority. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon. **If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's Attorney.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Passaic County Clerk's Office in Instrument Number: 2003034693, et seq. New Jersey, and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Passaic County.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
272 Kent Avenue Wayne, NJ 07470
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $211,088.69 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF
Advertised in the Passaic County Sheriff Website
DATED: April 6, 2026
Gross Poloway
95 Mount Bethel Road Suite 3
Warren, NJ 07059
